Purely temporary, maximum one semester (Monsoon semester)
Email, followed by a hard copy

content_sections.heading: About UoH Guest Faculty
content_sections.text: The notice is issued by the Dean, School of Medical Sciences, University of Hyderabad, Hyderabad-500 046, Telangana. The guest faculty will teach the B. Optometry course under the NCAHP new syllabus and curriculum, in the specializations listed in the notice.

content_sections.heading: Department-wise Vacancies
content_sections.text: The School of Medical Sciences has 2 Guest Faculty vacancies, both in the UR category. The notice prints the 2 posts as one total for Guest Faculty and does not split them between the Optometry/Anatomy specialization and the Communication course.

content_sections.heading: Qualification and Experience
content_sections.text: The notice lists two specializations, separated by "OR". Each has its own essential qualification and desirable criteria. Optometry / Anatomy: 1-year experience in teaching/research with a minimum of 2 publications (WoS or Scopus indexed). Optometry / Anatomy: ability to teach the following courses: General Anatomy. Communication course: PhD (English, Linguistics, Communication) with experience in teaching communication to Optometry or allied areas. Candidates should check the official notification for the exact specialization-wise eligibility before applying.

rows.qualification: M.Sc. Optometry with PhD (Optometry) OR B. Optometry with M.Sc. Optometry and PhD. OR M.Sc. (Anatomy) or PhD (Anatomy)/ MD(Anatomy)
rows.experience: Desirable: 1-year experience in teaching/research with a minimum of 2 publications (WoS or Scopus indexed)
Desirable: experience in teaching communication to Optometry or allied areas, with PhD

content_sections.heading: Pay and Terms
content_sections.text: The honorarium for guest faculty is as per UGC Guidelines (2019). The notice does not print an amount. The appointment is purely temporary in nature. The appointment will be for a maximum period of one semester (Monsoon semester), which the notice prints as "during Nov-Dec-2025". Selected candidates are expected to join the university within a week from the date of receipt of the offer.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for UoH Guest Faculty
content_sections.text: Prepare a softcopy of your CV along with your academic qualifications, research publications and work experience documents. Email the softcopy to both [email protected] and [email protected] on or before 14 November 2026. After emailing, send a hard copy of the application to: Dean, School of Medical Sciences, Old Science Complex building, University of Hyderabad, Hyderabad-500046, Telangana. Shortlisted candidates will be called for an interview; only shortlisted candidates will be called. The notice does not give a separate last date for receipt of the hard copy or the date of the interview.

content_sections.heading: Documents Required
content_sections.text: CV Academic qualification documents Research publications Work experience documents

content_sections.heading: Important Instructions
content_sections.text: No TA/DA will be provided for attending the interview. Sending the email alone is not enough: candidates must also send a hard copy of the application after emailing.

faq.question: Q1. How many Guest Faculty vacancies are in the UoH notification?
faq.answer: The School of Medical Sciences, University of Hyderabad, has 2 Guest Faculty vacancies, both in the UR category.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply for UoH Guest Faculty 2026?
faq.answer: Candidates must email their CV and documents on or before 14 November 2026, and then send a hard copy of the application.

faq.question: Q3. What qualification is needed for the Optometry/Anatomy Guest Faculty post?
faq.answer: The notice requires M.Sc. Optometry with PhD (Optometry) OR B. Optometry with M.Sc. Optometry and PhD, OR M.Sc. (Anatomy) or PhD (Anatomy)/ MD(Anatomy).

faq.question: Q4. What qualification is needed for the Communication course?
faq.answer: The essential qualification is M.A (Linguistics), M.A(English) or M.A(Communication). A PhD (English, Linguistics, Communication) with experience in teaching communication to Optometry or allied areas is desirable.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary of UoH Guest Faculty?
faq.answer: The honorarium for guest faculty is as per UGC Guidelines (2019); the notice does not print an amount.

faq.question: Q6. How do I apply for UoH Guest Faculty?
faq.answer: Email your CV with academic qualifications, research publications and work experience documents to [email protected] and [email protected], then send a hard copy to the Dean, School of Medical Sciences, Old Science Complex building, University of Hyderabad, Hyderabad-500046, Telangana.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process?
faq.answer: Only shortlisted candidates will be called for an interview.

faq.question: Q8. Is the UoH Guest Faculty job permanent?
faq.answer: No. The appointment is purely temporary and for a maximum period of one semester (Monsoon semester).

faq.question: Q9. Will TA/DA be paid for the interview?
faq.answer: No. The notice states that no TA/DA will be provided for attending the interview.

faq.question: Q10. How soon must selected candidates join?
faq.answer: Selected candidates are expected to join the university within a week from the date of receipt of the offer.
